body: @mysticatea Could you take a look please?

@fabienjuif 
It looks like you're using `babel-eslint` as your parser. Can you try using the default parser instead? You can just delete the `parser` from your config file to switch to the default parser. Make sure you configure the [parser options](http://eslint.org/docs/user-guide/configuring#specifying-parser-options) as well.

I had this problem and could reproduce the test case but it was fixed when I removed `react/jsx-uses-vars` https://github.com/yannickcr/eslint-plugin-react/blob/master/lib/rules/jsx-uses-vars.js from my config

@lukeapage Thank you for investigating.

`prefer-const` does not touch `var` declarations. :)
It's handling only `let` declarations.
